notes: Two branches, each its own group; the text writes no shared tail after «ح».
«وذكر، آخر» in the first branch is an editor's remark naming a further transmitter who is not written: left out, unresolved.
«أنبأنا غير، واحد، منهم المغيرة»: the unnamed «غير واحد» and Mughira share one level (rule 8).
Mu'awiya's letter is scene; the saying is Mughira's reply, relayed by his scribe Warrad (كاتب المغيرة), so Mughira is the last link.
